indications.description: Induction treatment for stage III–IV non-metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

treatment.schedule_summary: Docetaxel 75 mg/m² and cisplatin 75 mg/m² day 1; fluorouracil 1000 mg/m²/day days 1–4 as a continuous 96-hour infusion (source alternative daily 22-hour infusions); every 21 days for 3 induction cycles unless progression/unacceptable toxicity.

administration.duration_description: continuous 96 hours; alternative daily 22-hour infusions on days 1–4

action.message: Pre-existing neuropathy grade ≥2 is a source exclusion; distinguish from treatment-emergent neuropathy.

rules.explanation: Pre-existing neuropathy grade ≥2 is a source exclusion; distinguish from treatment-emergent neuropathy.

action.message: Significant hearing impairment/tinnitus is a source exclusion; do not substitute a generic grade-2 hearing cutoff.

rules.explanation: Significant hearing impairment/tinnitus is a source exclusion; do not substitute a generic grade-2 hearing cutoff.

action.message: Induction eligibility requires planned definitive chemoradiation and/or surgery.

rules.explanation: Induction eligibility requires planned definitive chemoradiation and/or surgery.

action.message: Pre-existing renal impairment is a source caution. Apply this document’s own renal table; do not import the <60 baseline exclusion from 00323/00324.

rules.explanation: Pre-existing renal impairment is a source caution. Apply this document’s own renal table; do not import the <60 baseline exclusion from 00323/00324.

action.message: Baseline eligibility states ANC >1.5 ×10⁹/L; do not start at or below 1.5 without resolving eligibility.

rules.explanation: Baseline eligibility states ANC >1.5 ×10⁹/L; do not start at or below 1.5 without resolving eligibility.

action.message: Delay until recovery; consider a 25% reduction of all three drugs in subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Delay until recovery; consider a 25% reduction of all three drugs in subsequent cycles.

action.message: Delay until recovery; consider reducing all three drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles (also applies below 50).

rules.explanation: Delay until recovery; consider reducing all three drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles (also applies below 50).

action.message: ANC 1.5 meets the on-treatment table but not the baseline >1.5 eligibility statement; select assessment phase.

rules.explanation: ANC 1.5 meets the on-treatment table but not the baseline >1.5 eligibility statement; select assessment phase.

action.message: After count recovery, consider reducing docetaxel, cisplatin and fluorouracil by 25% for subsequent cycles. Confirm prior dose reductions; the source does not specify repeated compounding.

rules.explanation: After count recovery, consider reducing docetaxel, cisplatin and fluorouracil by 25% for subsequent cycles. Confirm prior dose reductions; the source does not specify repeated compounding.

action.message: Urgent clinical assessment of febrile neutropenia. Complete event timing, G-CSF, recovery and dose history before choosing the source subsequent-cycle reduction.

rules.explanation: Urgent clinical assessment of febrile neutropenia. Complete event timing, G-CSF, recovery and dose history before choosing the source subsequent-cycle reduction.

action.message: Delay while complicated neutropenia is unresolved. Confirm count and clinical recovery before a subsequent-cycle dose.

rules.explanation: Delay while complicated neutropenia is unresolved. Confirm count and clinical recovery before a subsequent-cycle dose.

action.message: Complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF: recovery is not documented; no restart dose can be assigned.

rules.explanation: Complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF: recovery is not documented; no restart dose can be assigned.

action.message: On recovery after febrile/prolonged neutropenia or neutropenic infection despite G-CSF, reduce all three drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles. Confirm dose history and avoid automatically compounding prior reductions.

rules.explanation: On recovery after febrile/prolonged neutropenia or neutropenic infection despite G-CSF, reduce all three drugs by 25% for subsequent cycles. Confirm dose history and avoid automatically compounding prior reductions.

action.message: Toxicity persisting despite reduction and G-CSF requires treating-Consultant discussion of further dose de-escalation or regimen change; no fixed second reduction is supplied.

rules.explanation: Toxicity persisting despite reduction and G-CSF requires treating-Consultant discussion of further dose de-escalation or regimen change; no fixed second reduction is supplied.

action.message: G-CSF prophylaxis (standard or pegylated according to local policy) is required in every cycle. Arrange it before the next cycle.

source.section: Treatment footnote; p3 Table 2; p6 supportive care

rules.explanation: G-CSF prophylaxis (standard or pegylated according to local policy) is required in every cycle. Arrange it before the next cycle.

action.message: Cisplatin CrCl 50–59 mL/min: 75% of original dose. Verify current dose/history; this must not increase an already lower dose.

rules.explanation: Cisplatin CrCl 50–59 mL/min: 75% of original dose. Verify current dose/history; this must not increase an already lower dose.

action.message: Cisplatin CrCl 40–49 mL/min: 50% of original dose. Verify current dose/history; this must not increase an already lower dose.

rules.explanation: Cisplatin CrCl 40–49 mL/min: 50% of original dose. Verify current dose/history; this must not increase an already lower dose.

action.message: Cisplatin is not recommended at CrCl <40 mL/min; haemodialysis has a separate discretionary pathway.

rules.explanation: Cisplatin is not recommended at CrCl <40 mL/min; haemodialysis has a separate discretionary pathway.

action.message: CrCl <40: source says cisplatin is not recommended except for a separate haemodialysis consideration. Establish dialysis status; no dose is authorised.

rules.explanation: CrCl <40: source says cisplatin is not recommended except for a separate haemodialysis consideration. Establish dialysis status; no dose is authorised.

action.message: On haemodialysis, 50% of original cisplatin dose may be considered by Consultant/pharmacy. This is not an automatic contraindication or routine permission.

rules.explanation: On haemodialysis, 50% of original cisplatin dose may be considered by Consultant/pharmacy. This is not an automatic contraindication or routine permission.

action.message: CrCl strictly between 49 and 50 mL/min falls between printed integer bands. Do not round or silently interpolate; Consultant/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: CrCl strictly between 49 and 50 mL/min falls between printed integer bands. Do not round or silently interpolate; Consultant/pharmacy review.

action.message: CrCl strictly between 59 and 60 mL/min falls between printed integer bands. Do not round or silently interpolate; Consultant/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: CrCl strictly between 59 and 60 mL/min falls between printed integer bands. Do not round or silently interpolate; Consultant/pharmacy review.

action.message: Complete prescribed pre/post hydration and any required electrolyte correction before cisplatin; use local hydration policy.

rules.explanation: Complete prescribed pre/post hydration and any required electrolyte correction before cisplatin; use local hydration policy.

action.message: Complete DPD deficiency is a contraindication to fluorouracil.

rules.explanation: Complete DPD deficiency is a contraindication to fluorouracil.

action.message: Consider an individualised reduced starting dose for partial DPD deficiency. No fixed percentage is supplied. Dose may increase only with careful monitoring and absence of serious toxicity.

rules.explanation: Consider an individualised reduced starting dose for partial DPD deficiency. No fixed percentage is supplied. Dose may increase only with careful monitoring and absence of serious toxicity.

action.message: DPD phenotype and/or genotype testing is required before first fluorouracil unless previously tested. Resolve missing status before starting.

rules.explanation: DPD phenotype and/or genotype testing is required before first fluorouracil unless previously tested. Resolve missing status before starting.

action.message: Moderate/severe renal impairment may elevate uracil and cause a false diagnosis of DPD deficiency. Interpret phenotype cautiously and consider genotype; do not automatically relabel deficiency or assign a reduction.

rules.explanation: Moderate/severe renal impairment may elevate uracil and cause a false diagnosis of DPD deficiency. Interpret phenotype cautiously and consider genotype; do not automatically relabel deficiency or assign a reduction.

action.message: Fluorouracil is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment. Current 00315 no longer supplies bilirubin 85/AST 180 cutoffs.

rules.explanation: Fluorouracil is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment. Current 00315 no longer supplies bilirubin 85/AST 180 cutoffs.

action.message: The source expects no fluorouracil reduction for mild/moderate hepatic impairment only without renal impairment. Combined impairment needs Consultant/pharmacy judgement; no fixed dose is specified.

rules.explanation: The source expects no fluorouracil reduction for mild/moderate hepatic impairment only without renal impairment. Combined impairment needs Consultant/pharmacy judgement; no fixed dose is specified.

action.message: Mild/moderate hepatic advice is conditional on absence of renal impairment. Record renal status; no normal status is inferred.

rules.explanation: Mild/moderate hepatic advice is conditional on absence of renal impairment. Record renal status; no normal status is inferred.

action.message: Docetaxel not recommended if AST >10×ULN OR ALT >10×ULN OR ALP >6×ULN OR bilirubin >1.5×ULN.

rules.explanation: Docetaxel not recommended if AST >10×ULN OR ALT >10×ULN OR ALP >6×ULN OR bilirubin >1.5×ULN.

action.message: Table 4 first row: AST and/or ALT >1.5–5×ULN AND ALP >2.5–5×ULN AND normal bilirubin: consider 75% of original docetaxel. Confirm all values and dose history; consideration is not automatic dosing.

rules.explanation: Table 4 first row: AST and/or ALT >1.5–5×ULN AND ALP >2.5–5×ULN AND normal bilirubin: consider 75% of original docetaxel. Confirm all values and dose history; consideration is not automatic dosing.

action.message: Table 4 second row prints AST >5–10 OR ALT >5–10, AND ALP <6, AND/OR bilirubin ≤1–1.5×ULN, then consider 50% original dose. Boolean grouping and bilirubin range are ambiguous; review the whole row, do not auto-calculate 50%. Any not-recommended criterion overrides.

rules.explanation: Table 4 second row prints AST >5–10 OR ALT >5–10, AND ALP <6, AND/OR bilirubin ≤1–1.5×ULN, then consider 50% original dose. Boolean grouping and bilirubin range are ambiguous; review the whole row, do not auto-calculate 50%. Any not-recommended criterion overrides.

action.message: Exact ALP 6×ULN is omitted between <6 and >6 source rows. Resolve with Consultant; do not substitute ≥6.

rules.explanation: Exact ALP 6×ULN is omitted between <6 and >6 source rows. Resolve with Consultant; do not substitute ≥6.

action.message: ALP >5 to <6 with transaminases ≤5 and normal bilirubin is not clearly assigned by the first/second rows; review rather than infer a dose.

rules.explanation: ALP >5 to <6 with transaminases ≤5 and normal bilirubin is not clearly assigned by the first/second rows; review rather than infer a dose.

action.message: Delay treatment until diarrhoea has resolved to grade ≤1 before the table’s subsequent-cycle modification.

Baseline ANC >1.5 ×10⁹/L; platelet eligibility prints 100 ×10⁹/L without a comparator—consult source/count table
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to docetaxel, cisplatin, fluorouracil or an excipient

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
supportive_care.docetaxel_dexamethasone: 8 mg orally twice daily for 3 days starting the day before docetaxel; at least 3 doses pre-treatment. If missed, 20 mg IV immediately before treatment may be considered by the prescribing Consultant.
supportive_care.cisplatin_hydration: Required before and after cisplatin, according to local policy and source suggested schedule. Routine furosemide is not recommended unless fluid overload.
supportive_care.gcsf: Required in all cycles; standard or pegylated according to local policy.
supportive_care.antimicrobial_prophylaxis: Trial ciprofloxacin 500 mg twice daily days 5–15 may be added at physician discretion/local policy; not universally required.

baseline: ECG if cardiac function is compromised
Audiology and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated
DPD phenotype and/or genotype before first fluorouracil unless previously tested
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Individualised to treatment plan and supervising Consultant; no fixed imaging interval is supplied.
monitoring.dpd_renal_caution: Uracil phenotyping may overdiagnose DPD deficiency in moderate/severe renal impairment; consider genotype.
